signals.text: O'Reilly to miss Czech Republic game but Konsa in squad. Nico O'Reilly is ruled out of England's Nations League match against the Czech Republic on Tuesday night bu Ezri Konsa is set to be in the squad.

Wales without seven players for World Cup play-off. Ceri Holland is one of seven players who will miss out through injury when a depleted Wales squad take on Albania in their Women's World Cup play-off semi-final next month.
